Gaby Striano graduated from Northwestern University in 2025 with a B.S. in journalism. Her work has appeared in ABC News, United Press International and Retro Report.

Gaby has reported on a range of issues across the globe, from the Russia-Ukraine war to the investigation of the Cornell 7. Her coverage spans social, print and documentary reporting, as she is committed to meeting audiences wherever and however they consume news.

Based in — New York, NY
